Ana M.: Quick sync — NorthGrid (new SI) sent a pipelist, lots of overlap with cloud marketplace deals. we need a clear handoff flow.
Owen R.: Can we map overlap by account stage? we should avoid duplicate outreach.
Mireya (SI): FYI we only have rights to engage for accounts in stage 2 per our MOU (clause 3.2). not stage 1.
Sean - Sales: If they're stage 1, AE keeps. Stage 2+ we allow co-sell; require AE opt-in and set SFDC tag 'co-sell_SI'.
Jin - Partnerships: Proposed rule: SI primary if SI originated the demo + AE consent. Otherwise AE owner, SI referral credit.
Owen R.: Add routing rule: if account marketplace_region = "us-west" route initial intro to partner-desk. else AE.
Ana M.: I'll draft an account matrix that marks origin, stage, marketplace flag, and suggested owner.
Mireya (SI): Also note: hardware partner (GigaChip) requires co-brand approval for joint announcements — keep comms aligned.
Sean - Sales: Action items: 1) Ana post account-level matrix by EOD 2) Jin update SFDC field spec (co-sell_SI + origin_proof) 3) Mireya confirm demo origins list
marketplace-bot: New file uploaded: s3://redwood-prod/partnerships/northgrid-pipeline.csv
Ana M.: Uploaded draft mapping here: https://confluence.redwood.team/partnerships/pipeline-confluence-draft — please comment inline.
Owen R.: Suggest a soft-fallback: if partner can't engage within 7 days, AE regains outreach rights (prevents stale leads).
Mireya (SI): 7 days works. We'll add weekly sync cadence to confirm engagement.
Sean - Sales: Also require claim evidence: demo recording or intro email when partner claims a lead. prevents duplicate origin claims.
Jin - Partnerships: I'll add that to the intake checklist and notify marketplace ops + legal for announcement cadence constraints.
Ana M.: I'll convert notes to a one-pager titled 'SI Co-sell Routing & Rules of Engagement' and share for signoff tomorrow.
Owen R.: pls DM me before finalizing for enterprise multi-org edge cases.
Mireya (SI): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
